name: winrdp-mcp
description: Provision and fully administer any Windows RDP box (Win10/11/Server) over WinRM/SSH/SMB.
long_description: Zero-config MCP server that brings a Windows box under management with one call and then exposes 144 tools to run it: elevated PowerShell/Python, files and fast transfer, RDP control, desktop/GUI automation, networking, scheduling, and security ops. Built for Claude and Claude Code.
